name: novel-p0-third-party-upstream-final
argv: import {readFile} from "node:fs/promises"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; const doc=JSON.parse(await readFile("docs/third-party/novel-donors.json","utf8")); const results=[]; for (const donor of doc.donors) { const parts=donor.repository.replace(/\/$/,"").split("/"); const owner=parts.at(-2); const repo=parts.at(-1); const headers={"User-Agent":"ai-canvas-novel-provenance-audit"}; const commitUrl="https://api.github.com/repos/"+owner+"/"+repo+"/git/commits/"+donor.commit; const commitResponse=await fetch(commitUrl,{headers}); if(!commitResponse.ok) throw new Error(donor.name+" commit HTTP "+commitResponse.status); const commitObject=await commitResponse.json(); if(commitObject.sha!==donor.commit||commitObject.tree?.sha!==donor.tree) throw new Error(donor.name+" commit/tree mismatch"); const files=[{path:donor.license.upstreamPath,sha256:donor.license.upstreamSha256,bytes:donor.license.upstreamBytes,kind:"license"},...donor.sourceFiles.map((file)=>({...file,kind:"source"}))]; const fileResults=[]; for (const file of files) { const rawUrl="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/"+owner+"/"+repo+"/"+donor.commit+"/"+file.path.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/"); const response=await fetch(rawUrl,{headers}); if(!response.ok) throw new Error(donor.name+" "+file.path+" HTTP "+response.status); const bytes=Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()); const sha256=createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"); const expectedBytes=file.bytes??null; if(sha256!==file.sha256||(expectedBytes!==null&&bytes.length!==expectedBytes)) throw new Error(donor.name+" "+file.path+" digest/size mismatch"); fileResults.push({kind:file.kind,path:file.path,httpStatus:response.status,bytes:bytes.length,sha256}); } results.push({name:donor.name,repository:donor.repository,commit:commitObject.sha,tree:commitObject.tree.sha,commitHttpStatus:commitResponse.status,files:fileResults}); } console.log(JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:1,kind:"novel-third-party-upstream-live-verification",verifiedAt:new Date().toISOString(),networkMode:"read-only-github-api-and-raw",donors:results,summary:{donors:results.length,commits:results.length,trees:results.length,files:results.reduce((n,d)=>n+d.files.length,0),allMatched:true}},null,2));
